sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 31 points from 15 games, travel to Telford Town on Saturday 7 November for a 15:00 kick-off. Despite back-to-back league losses most recently, Sandbach remain in commanding position and face opponents in the relegation zone—Telford have won just once all season and are among the division's poorest performers.
divisionWide: Saturday's fixtures see a cluster of title-race contenders in action. Second-placed Stafford Town host AFC Bridgnorth (fifth, 27 points), while third-placed Eccleshall face New Mills and fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals take on Foley Meir. Eccleshall arrive in excellent form with three consecutive wins, while Wolverhampton Casuals have been dominant with four wins in five. AFC Bridgnorth, unbeaten in their last three league games, should be competitive at Stafford. Elsewhere, Allscott Heath (sixth in form with four wins in five) host Wednesfield Community; Bilston Town (eighth, recently losing form) entertain Cheadle Heath Nomads; Barnton (seventh, strong form) play Market Drayton Town; Alsager Town travel to face Widnes Town (both in the bottom tier of form and points); Crewe host Dawley Town; and Brereton Social play Shawbury United in a clash between two struggling mid-table sides. On Tuesday, Widnes Town visit Sandbach. Wednesday brings midweek action with Bilston Town hosting Alsager Town and Wolverhampton Casuals facing New Mills (20:00 KO).
